The '''X-222''' was a high-altitude fighter often referred to as a '''triple-deuce''' fighter.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|339|}}</ref>

These starships were considered outdated during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
